A Nevitt Construction

A site for a family-run building contractor in Hayle, built with SEO, covering everything from single-storey extensions to full design-and-build new homes. The work is organised by service so a homeowner can find the job they have in mind, and the whole of west Cornwall is covered without a page per town.

The search side of this build is the same GEO work covered in what GEO is and why it matters for trades, and it is included on the Growth plan.
